about_the_game:
The fate of the kingdom is in your hands.

Once a prosperous realm, the kingdom now lies in ruins after a devastating invasion. The royal family has fallen, and the young princess is trapped behind enemy lines.
With only a few loyal knights left, it's time to rise from the ashes and fight back.

Elgracia: A Kingdom's Chronicle is a turn-based tactical SRPG that reimagines the charm of classic strategy games for modern players.
Each turn, every move matters. Lead unique heroes through perilous battlefields, rescue the princess, and reclaim your homeland.

  • Tactics decide survival – Use terrain and unit skills to outsmart and overwhelm your enemies.

  • Grow with your allies – Build bonds with your companions and uncover their stories as the war unfolds.

  • Rebuild your legacy – Manage resources, recover strongholds, and restore the glory of your fallen kingdom.

In an age of crisis, a new legend begins.
Lead your army. Reclaim your throne.

name: Elgracia: A Kingdom's Chronicle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Rescue the princess and rebuild a fallen kingdom. Elgracia: A Kingdom's Chronicle is a story-driven tactical SRPG with deep turn-based strategy.
supported_languages:
English*, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
